description.en: Loads the objective (purpose) message for the current story state into the objective display and returns that display's handle, so the script can wait for it with CMND_IS_LOADING. If there is no objective message for the current state, nothing is loaded and false is returned.

The objective display handle once the load is started.
false if there is no objective message for the current state.
null if the script system is not ready.

examples.case: After a heal (real usage, from ev42061300.nut)
